warning.titlePre: Mercedes CLK 63 AMG Camshaft Adjuster & Head Bolt Wear
paragraphs: If your CLK 63 AMG has the M156 6.2-litre V8 - that's every C209-generation car - camshaft adjuster and head bolt wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, confirmed by established AMG specialist consensus. We replace the timing chain, camshaft adjuster, and bearings as standard on every M156 rebuild.
